problems_and_friction: No protocol was given, so I had to infer the handoff convention from the files themselves (three .md analyses plus per-role pick.json files); that worked but cost a discovery pass. An empty work/snapshots subdirectory was a confusing leftover that got copied into snapshots/final as an empty dir. The only real synthesis work was reconciling magnitudes (paid-seat count 25 vs role-implied ~22, run-rate vs year-1 all-in cost, divergent Salesforce admin-cost estimates) since all three specialists agreed on HubSpot at 4/5, leaving no vendor-level disagreement to arbitrate.
context_understood: Synthesize three concurrent specialist analyses (market research, risk, team adoption) of Salesforce vs HubSpot vs Zoho for a 40-person Dublin ad agency into one client-ready costed recommendation with a 3-phase rollout plan, then snapshot and write a receipt.
